property_summary: For any successful transfer, the calldata sent to caddress must be abi.encodeWithSelector(transferFrom(address,address,uint256), from, _tos[i], v), so a recording callee must observe msg.sender specified as `from` and receiver as `_tos[i]`; the mutated argument order sends `from` as the amount and `v` as the receiver, which the recorder distinguishes.
change_summary: Swap the arguments to abi.encodeWithSelector, passing from as the token amount and v as the destination, i.e. selector(id, from, v, _tos[i]).
